common_conditions: TS23.280 V19.9.0; single MC system; Stage2
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: LMS configures requested information and triggers; configuration may be in user profile so a configuration message is unnecessary. Later partial updates retain previous values for unchanged IEs.

conditions: Configured event occurs, or LMS sends on-demand request
claims.conclusion: LMC reports information identified by LMS and available to LMC; on-demand response is immediate. LMS updates/stores received location and any optional UE label. No fresh-measurement or accuracy guarantee follows.

limitations: No complete configuration IE set, trigger aggregation or Stage3 encoding.
On-demand authorization and dissemination are separate; see related usage topic.
